name: PR13 exact-SHA software validation (without G5)
# One-off isolated validation branch; never modify PR #13 or default workflows.
# This workflow is intentionally NOT triggered from push to main or normal PRs.
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'automation/validation/pr13-exact-head-20261017-001'
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/pr13-exact-head-once.yml'
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: cteas-pr13-one-time-validation
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  native:
    name: Ubuntu C++20 ${{ matrix.suite }} CTest
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        suite: [inputs, p1, p3, p4, p5, p6, p6e, p6f, p7]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout immutable PR13 implementation, not the trigger workflow commit
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Enforce exact SHA and frozen reference integrity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671"
          if [ "${{ matrix.suite }}" = p6f ] || [ "${{ matrix.suite }}" = p7 ]; then
            echo "b1823cda92280888d70b00961ab39486036a3086e18637fff21efb4f4b237d30  project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/met/met.dat" | sha256sum -c -
            echo "0d51bdb68ff1a5798048bc41067107d3ffe10dc6222f25336df856bcbf48ba10  project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/puff/puff.con" | sha256sum -c -
          fi
          echo "VALIDATED_PR13_SOURCE_SHA=0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install native dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends g++-12 gfortran-11 libgdal-dev
          python -m pip install numpy==2.4.4 pandas==3.0.2 pyyaml==6.0.3
      - name: Run portable suite at exact PR13 SHA
        env:
          CXX: /usr/bin/g++-12
          FC: /usr/bin/gfortran-11
        run: |
          python scripts/migration/validate_ubuntu.py --suite "${{ matrix.suite }}" --portable --jobs 2 --out "${{ runner.temp }}/cteas-pr13-${{ matrix.suite }}"
      - name: Archive the suite's CMake and CTest evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr13-ubuntu-${{ matrix.suite }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/cteas-pr13-${{ matrix.suite }}/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/cteas-pr13-${{ matrix.suite }}/*.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/cteas-pr13-${{ matrix.suite }}/build-*/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
  python-data-only:
    name: P4/P5 Python unittest (explicitly exclude G5)
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install data-preparation test dependencies only
        run: |
          python -m pip install numpy==2.4.4 pandas==3.0.2 pyyaml==6.0.3
      - name: Verify exact SHA, select only P4/P5 and run
        env:
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671"
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          import sys
          import unittest
          from pathlib import Path
          root=Path.cwd()
          sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
          def flatten(suite):
              for x in suite:
                  if isinstance(x,unittest.TestSuite):
                      yield from flatten(x)
                  else:
                      yield x
          paths=("native_cpp/modules/p4_read62/data_prep/tests","native_cpp/modules/p5_smerge/data_prep/tests")
          suite=[]
          skipped=[]
          for path in paths:
              for t in flatten(unittest.TestLoader().discover(str(root/path),pattern="test_*.py")):
                  if t.id()=="test_p5_rules.P5MissingPolicyTests.test_original_smerge_calmet_calm_source_contract":
                      skipped.append(t.id())
                  else:
                      suite.append(t)
          assert suite, "P4/P5 discovery returned no tests"
          assert len(skipped)==1, "expected one external-only test to remain excluded"
          result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.TestSuite(suite))
          out=dict(source_sha="0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671",suite="P4_P5_ONLY",g5_tests_run=0,
                   tests_run=result.testsRun,failures=len(result.failures),
                   errors=len(result.errors),external_not_run=skipped,
                   status="PASS_SOFTWARE" if result.wasSuccessful() else "FAIL")
          print("PR13_P4_P5_SOFTWARE="+json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
          assert result.wasSuccessful()
          PY
  docker-packaging:
    name: Docker AMD64 builder/runtime (G5 verification stage intentionally skipped)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Enforce exact source identity and AMD64
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671"
          test "$(docker info --format '{{.Architecture}}')" = x86_64 || test "$(docker info --format '{{.Architecture}}')" = amd64
          echo "DOCKER_SOURCE_SHA=0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671"
      - name: Build C++ portable package only (no GUI/G5 installation)
        run: |
          docker build --progress=plain --file docker/cpp/Dockerfile --target builder --tag cteas-next:pr13-builder .
          docker build --progress=plain --file docker/cpp/Dockerfile --target runtime --build-arg SOURCE_REVISION="0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671" --tag cteas-next:pr13-runtime .
      - name: Verify the stripped native runtime image (no G5)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Architecture}}' cteas-next:pr13-runtime)" = amd64
          docker run --rm cteas-next:pr13-runtime
          docker run --rm cteas-next:pr13-runtime /bin/sh -ec '
            test "$(id -u)" = 10001
            test "$(find /opt/cteas/bin -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 11
            test ! -e /src && test ! -e /engine/vendor
            for cmd in cteas_p1_terrain cteas_p2_gen_fraction cteas_p3_makegeo \
                       cteas_p4_read62 cteas_p5_smerge cteas_p6_realcase_wind_field \
                       cteas_p6_native_hourly_driver cteas_p6f_calmet_dat21_writer \
                       cteas_p7_calmet21_inspect cteas_p7_native_met_hours \
                       cteas_p7_2022_case_ledger; do
              command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null
            done'
          echo PR13_DOCKER_AMD64_BUILD_RUNTIME=PASS_SOFTWARE

name: PR13 one-shot native-only AMD64 container build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/verification/pr13-native-20261017
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr13-native-container-20261017.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docker-amd64-runtime-only:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 75
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 4
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Validate exact PR13 pinned checkout
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/pr13-native-container-20261017.yml"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor 0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671 HEAD
          git checkout --detach 0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671"
          echo "TESTED_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - name: Build native AMD64 runtime image, no G5 tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker build --progress=plain --file docker/cpp/Dockerfile --target runtime \
            --build-arg SOURCE_REVISION=0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671 \
            -t cteas-next:pr13-native-amd64 .
          test "$(docker image inspect cteas-next:pr13-native-amd64 --format '{{.Architecture}}')" = "amd64"
          docker run --rm cteas-next:pr13-native-amd64
          echo "PR13_NATIVE_AMD64_RUNTIME_BUILD=PASS_SOFTWARE"

name: PR13 one-shot native P1-P7 software regression
# Explicitly scoped to a disposable verification branch, NOT main / PR pushes.
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/verification/pr13-native-20261017
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr13-native-software-regression-20261017.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pr13-native-20261017
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  native-cpp:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        suite: [inputs, p1, p3, p4, p5, p6, p6e, p6f, p7]
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify one-shot request and switch to PR13 exact head
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671"
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/pr13-native-software-regression-20261017.yml"
          git checkout --detach 0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671"
          echo "PR13_TESTED_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install compiler and C++ validation dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends g++-12 gfortran-11 libgdal-dev
          python -m pip install numpy==2.4.4 pandas==3.0.2 pyyaml==6.0.3
      - name: Run portable CMake / CTest (no GUI/G5)
        env:
          CXX: /usr/bin/g++-12
          FC: /usr/bin/gfortran-11
        run: |
          python scripts/migration/validate_ubuntu.py --suite "${{ matrix.suite }}" --out "${{ runner.temp }}/cteas-pr13-${{ matrix.suite }}" --jobs 2 --portable
      - name: Preserve regression evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr13-native-${{ matrix.suite }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cteas-pr13-${{ matrix.suite }}
          retention-days: 14

  p4-p5-python:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Pin PR13 exact head
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671"
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/pr13-native-software-regression-20261017.yml"
          git checkout --detach 0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Run only P4 and P5 Python tests (G5 excluded by request)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install numpy==2.4.4 pandas==3.0.2 pyyaml==6.0.3
          python -m unittest discover -s native_cpp/modules/p4_read62/data_prep/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
          python -m unittest discover -s native_cpp/modules/p5_smerge/data_prep/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
      - name: Check locked reference binary SHA256
        run: |
          echo "b1823cda92280888d70b00961ab39486036a3086e18637fff21efb4f4b237d30  project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/met/met.dat" | sha256sum --check
          echo "0d51bdb68ff1a5798048bc41067107d3ffe10dc6222f25336df856bcbf48ba10  project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/puff/puff.con" | sha256sum --check

name: PR13 one-shot P4-P5 Python portable regression
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/verification/pr13-native-20261017
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr13-python-portable-20261017.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  p4-p5-portable:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 3
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify exact source SHA and isolated workflow trigger
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/pr13-python-portable-20261017.yml"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor 0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671 HEAD
          git checkout --detach 0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0d0cb09012b6cacd7f6f3a406b865e3b2a38c671"
          echo "SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install exact portable Python dependencies
        run: python -m pip install numpy==2.4.4 pandas==3.0.2 pyyaml==6.0.3
      - name: Execute upstream portable selector, only P4/P5, G5 deferred
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import importlib.util
          import sys
          from pathlib import Path
          path=Path("scripts/migration/validate_python.py").resolve()
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("cteas_portable_validation",path)
          mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
          spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
          expected=["native_cpp/modules/p4_read62/data_prep/tests","native_cpp/modules/p5_smerge/data_prep/tests"]
          assert mod.PATHS[:2] == expected, "P4/P5 suite definition changed"
          mod.PATHS=expected
          sys.argv=["python-portable", "--portable", "--out", "/tmp/cteas-pr13-python-p4p5"]
          raise SystemExit(mod.main())
          PY
          cat /tmp/cteas-pr13-python-p4p5/python-results.json
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          root=Path("/tmp/cteas-pr13-python-p4p5")
          r=json.loads((root/"python-results.json").read_text())
          p=json.loads((root/"python-selection.json").read_text())
          assert r["status"]=="PASS_SOFTWARE", r
          assert r["not_run"]==1, r
          assert {x["name"] for x in p if x["status"]=="NOT_RUN"} == {
            "test_p5_rules.P5MissingPolicyTests.test_original_smerge_calmet_calm_source_contract"
          }
          assert all("gui_g5" not in x["name"].lower() and "test_g5_" not in x["name"].lower() for x in p)
          print("PR13_P4_P5_PORTABLE_ONLY=PASS; G5_NOT_RUN=true; excluded_vendor_tests=1")
          PY
      - name: Verify immutable 2022 science baseline hashes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "b1823cda92280888d70b00961ab39486036a3086e18637fff21efb4f4b237d30  project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/met/met.dat" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "0d51bdb68ff1a5798048bc41067107d3ffe10dc6222f25336df856bcbf48ba10  project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/puff/puff.con" | sha256sum -c -
      - name: Upload portable validation reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr13-python-p4-p5-only
          path: /tmp/cteas-pr13-python-p4p5/
          retention-days: 14
